## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D chess game featuring characters from Chainsaw Man.

## Requirements
- Build now without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px wide) and inspect only the latest.

## Decisions
- Created a dark, Tokyo Special Division 4–themed chess experience with custom Three.js character figures and standard chess rules.
- Assumed local two-player play; added touch-friendly responsive layout, board orbit/zoom, move history, capture display, undo, reset, and sound toggle.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added the game UI and Three.js chess implementation in `index.html`.
- Installed Chromium, launched a local server with `python3 -m http.server 3002`, and captured/inspected `screenshots/latest.jpg`.
- Verified a pawn selection, legal move, turn change, and undo via Playwright.

### Active
- Fix and retest chess edge cases and interaction behavior.
- Confirm the latest implementation after the final edits; document assumptions and checks when finishing.

### Blocked
- Browser showed a 404 for `/favicon.ico`; nonessential.
- No other blocker.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `index.html` chess move logic, especially `attacked()` pawn direction, en passant capture recording/undo, promotion, and castling.
2. Run Playwright checks for picking pieces, legal/illegal moves, a black reply, and undo; inspect console errors.
3. Refresh `screenshots/latest.jpg` (≤1280px viewport) if visual changes are made.
4. Summarize the completed game and assumptions to the user.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: all markup, styling, 3D scene, character figures, and chess/game logic.
- `screenshots/latest.jpg`: latest visual check.
- `start.sh`: repository startup wrapper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Development server is at `http://localhost:3002`.
- One Playwright check successfully selected Pochita, moved it, changed to Devil’s turn, and undid the move.
